mainTopic: Is תרומת הדשן a full עבודה? Its garments, its amount, and whether a זר who performs it gets מיתה (רב vs. לוי).
overview: This עמוד opens in the middle of a ברייתא about תרומת הדשן, the removal of ashes from the מזבח. רבי דוסא reads ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ as including worn-out garments, and a related ברייתא shows him allowing the כהן גדול's יום הכפורים garments to be reused by a כהן הדיוט. The גמרא suggests that רבי יהודה and רבי דוסא argue over whether תרומת הדשן is a real עבודה. It rejects this: both agree it is an עבודה, and they argue only about whether a פסוק is needed to teach that. Next, רבי אבין asks how much ash must be lifted, and a ברייתא of רבי חייא answers with a גזירה שוה from the מנחה: a handful. Then רב lists four services for which a זר gets מיתה, and לוי adds תרומת הדשן. The גמרא traces both views to במדבר יח:ז. רב excludes removal through ״עבודת מתנה״, while לוי includes it through ״דבר המזבח״. Finally, the גמרא challenges לוי with the rule of כלל ופרט. The answer begins with ״אמר קרא״ and continues on the next עמוד.

steps.title: רבי דוסא: the extra word includes worn-out garments
steps.stepSummary: This line completes רבי דוסא's statement from the previous עמוד. He reads ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ as teaching that worn-out garments may still be used for the עבודה.
steps.simpleTranslation: [The word ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ comes] to include worn-out garments.
steps.whatsHappening: We are finishing a sentence that started on the previous עמוד. רבי דוסא says the word ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ teaches that faded, worn garments are still kosher for the עבודה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה used ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ to add the מצנפת and אבנט to the list of garments needed for תרומת הדשן. רבי דוסא uses the same word for something else: worn garments are still valid as long as they are not torn. This leaves רבי דוסא without רבי יהודה's source for requiring four garments, and the גמרא will soon build on that.

keyTerms.meaning: to include; the פסוק adds something extra
worn-out, faded garments that are not yet torn
"he shall wear"; the word in the פסוק being expounded

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a brand-new statement. It is the tail end of רבי דוסא's opinion, which began on the previous עמוד. Read it together with the ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ discussion there.

phrases.english: to include worn-out garments.
phrases.notes: This finishes רבי דוסא's teaching from the word ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ (ויקרא ו:ג).

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the ברייתא from the previous עמוד, giving רבי דוסא's alternative דרשה on ״יִלְבַּשׁ״.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי דוסא, ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ teaches that worn-out garments are still valid for the עבודה.

steps.title: The יום הכפורים linen garments must be stored away
steps.stepSummary: A new ברייתא opens. Its first opinion learns from ״וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם״ that the כהן גדול's linen garments from יום הכפורים must be put away and never used again.
steps.simpleTranslation: "And he shall leave them there": this teaches that they require being stored away.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another ברייתא in which רבי דוסא also appears, this one about the כהן גדול's יום הכפורים garments. This step gives the first opinion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says the כהן גדול takes off the linen garments ״וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם״. The first opinion reads "leave them there" literally. The garments must be hidden away permanently and cannot be used by anyone.

keyTerms.meaning: "and he shall leave them there" (ויקרא טז:כג)
they require being stored away and may not be used again
it teaches

phrases.english: "And he shall leave them there":
phrases.notes: Quoted from ויקרא טז:כג, about the linen garments of יום הכפורים.

phrases.english: teaches that they require being stored away.
phrases.notes: The first, anonymous opinion in the ברייתא.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a related ברייתא that also involves רבי דוסא and the reuse of priestly garments.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The first opinion holds that the כהן גדול's linen garments from יום הכפורים must be stored away permanently.

steps.title: רבי דוסא: the garments may be used by a כהן הדיוט
steps.stepSummary: רבי דוסא disagrees. The garments may be used by a כהן הדיוט. ״וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם״ only means the כהן גדול cannot wear them on another יום הכפורים.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי דוסא says: they are fit for an ordinary priest. So what does the פסוק mean by "and he shall leave them there"? That he should not use them on another יום הכפורים.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי דוסא says the garments do not need to be hidden away. He reinterprets the פסוק so that it fits his view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי דוסא asks his own question: if the garments can be reused, what does "leave them there" teach? His answer is that the restriction is narrow. The כהן גדול may not wear the same set on a future יום הכפורים, but a כהן הדיוט may use them. Like his reading of ״יִלְבַּשׁ״, this shows his general approach that garments already used are still usable.

keyTerms.meaning: the תנא who disputes the first opinion
an ordinary priest, not the כהן גדול
"What does the פסוק come to teach?"; a formula that asks what a verse is for
fit, valid for use

phrases.english: Rabbi Dosa says:
they are fit for an ordinary priest,
and what does the verse teach by "and he shall leave them there"?
phrases.notes: רבי דוסא anticipates the challenge from the פסוק.

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהֶן יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים אַחֵר.
phrases.english: that he should not use them on another Yom Kippur.
phrases.notes: The ban applies only to the כהן גדול on a future יום הכפורים.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי דּוֹסָא אוֹמֵר רְאוּיִן הֵן לְכֹהֵן הֶדְיוֹט
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the disputing opinion within the same ברייתא.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהן גדול's יום הכפורים garments may be used by a כהן הדיוט. The only ban is on the כהן גדול reusing them on another יום הכפורים.

steps.title: Suggestion: the תנאים argue over whether תרומת הדשן is a full עבודה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא returns to רבי יהודה and רבי דוסא's dispute over ״יִלְבַּשׁ״. It suggests they disagree about whether תרומת הדשן is an עבודה, the same question as רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש.
steps.simpleTranslation: Is it not about this that they disagree? One master holds it is a Temple service, and the other master holds it is not a Temple service.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא proposes that the amoraic dispute already exists among the תנאים. It frames this as a question that it will test in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה uses ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ to require all four garments, which fits treating תרומת הדשן as a full עבודה. רבי דוסא uses ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ for worn garments, so he has no source for four garments. That seems to mean he thinks it is not an עבודה and two garments are enough. If this is right, רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש would simply be repeating a dispute of the תנאים.

keyTerms.meaning: "Is it not that...?"; introduces a suggested reading
they disagree
a real Temple service, requiring full priestly garments
"one master holds"

steps.confusionAlert: "One master" here is רבי יהודה, who says it is an עבודה. "The other master" is רבי דוסא, who would say it is not. It is not the two sides of the ״וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם״ ברייתא.

phrases.english: Is it not about this that they disagree:
phrases.notes: "They" means רבי יהודה and רבי דוסא, in the ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ dispute.

phrases.english: that one master holds it is a Temple service,
phrases.notes: רבי יהודה: all four garments are required.

phrases.english: and one master holds it is not a Temple service.
phrases.notes: רבי דוסא: only two garments would be needed.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the ״וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם״ side point and returns to the main question about תרומת הדשן.
steps.raayaObject: That the dispute of רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש over whether תרומת הדשן is an עבודה is already a dispute of the תנאים.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ dispute: רבי יהודה derives four garments, while רבי דוסא uses the word for worn garments.

steps.title: Rejection: everyone agrees it is a service; they argue only about the need for a verse
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the suggestion. Both רבי יהודה and רבי דוסא agree that תרומת הדשן is an עבודה with four garments. רבי יהודה thinks a פסוק is needed to teach this, and רבי דוסא thinks it is obvious.
steps.simpleTranslation: No. Everyone agrees it is a Temple service. Here they disagree about this: one master holds a verse is needed to include [the other garments], and one master holds a verse is not needed to include them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on the suggestion. It explains the dispute differently so that the תנאים do not argue about the עבודה question at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The halacha is the same for both: four garments. The only argument is about the source. רבי יהודה needs ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ to teach it. רבי דוסא says that since it is an עבודה, four garments are obvious, so the word is free to teach about worn garments. That means we cannot prove the amoraic dispute from these תנאים.

keyTerms.meaning: everyone; all opinions agree
a פסוק is needed
to include (Aramaic form of לרבות)
"and here"; introduces the real point of the dispute

steps.whatToRemember: A disagreement about where a law is learned from is not always a disagreement about the law itself. Here רבי יהודה and רבי דוסא both require four garments for תרומת הדשן. They differ only on whether a פסוק is needed to teach it. So the dispute of רבי יוחנן and ריש לקיש is not proven to be a dispute of the תנאים.
steps.whyThisMatters: This is a common גמרא move: the גמרא avoids making amoraim depend on a dispute of the תנאים by reducing the argument to one about sources only. It keeps both amoraic positions open.

phrases.english: No, everyone agrees it is a Temple service,
and here they disagree about this:
one master holds a verse is needed to include [the other garments],
phrases.notes: רבי יהודה: ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ is needed to add the מצנפת and אבנט.

phrases.aramaic: וּמָר סָבַר: לָא צְרִיכָא קְרָא לְרַבּוֹיֵי.
phrases.english: and one master holds a verse is not needed to include them.
phrases.notes: רבי דוסא: since it is an עבודה, four garments are obvious, so ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ teaches about worn garments.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the suggestion of step 4 by moving the dispute from the law to its source.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the claim that רבי יהודה and רבי דוסא disagree about whether תרומת הדשן is an עבודה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: Step 4 assumed that רבי דוסא's not using ״יִלְבַּשׁ״ for four garments means he rejects four garments. In fact he may hold four garments are obvious and need no פסוק.

steps.title: How much ash must be lifted?
steps.stepSummary: רבי אבין asks what amount of ash is needed for תרומת הדשן. Is it learned from תרומת מעשר or from the donation taken from the spoils of מדין?
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אבין asked: How much ash is taken for תרומת הדשן? Do we learn it from תרומת מעשר, or from the donation taken from the spoils of מדין?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אבין opens a new question about the size of תרומת הדשן. The גמרא is setting up an answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה calls the ash-lifting a תרומה, so we may learn its amount from another kind of תרומה. תרומת מעשר is a tenth of the לוי's tithe, which is one hundredth of the crop. The donation from the spoils of מדין was one five-hundredth. Each model would give a different percentage of the ash.

keyTerms.meaning: He asked; raised a dilemma (the next step answers it)
How much? What amount?
The tenth that the לוי gives to the כהן from his own tithe
The portion taken from the spoils of the war with מדין (במדבר ל״א)
We learn it from; we derive it from

phrases.english: Rabbi Avin asked:
The removal of the ashes, how much is it?
Do we learn it from the teruma of the tithe,
phrases.notes: That model gives one hundredth of the total.

phrases.english: or do we learn it from the donation of Midian?
phrases.notes: That model gives one five-hundredth of the total.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: This opens a new question about תרומת הדשן, the עבודה that steps 4-5 were discussing.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What amount of ash is needed for תרומת הדשן, and which תרומה is the model for learning it?

steps.title: A handful, learned from the מנחה
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא of רבי חייא answers with a גזירה שוה on the word ״והרים״. Just as the קמיצה of a מנחה is a handful, תרומת הדשן is a handful too.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear. רבי חייא taught: Here it says ״והרים״ (he shall lift), and elsewhere it says ״והרים״. Just as there it is a handful, so too here it is a handful.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers רבי אבין's question with a ברייתא. The amount is a handful.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Neither model רבי אבין offered is used. Instead, the word ״והרים״ is used for both תרומת הדשן and the קמיצה of a מנחה, so we learn one from the other. The amount is a fixed handful, not a percentage of the pile.

keyTerms.meaning: Come and hear; a source is brought to answer a question
And he shall lift up
It says here... and it says there; the form of a גזירה שוה
With his handful (three middle fingers closed over the palm)

steps.whatToRemember: The amount of ash for תרומת הדשן is a קומץ (handful), learned from ״והרים״ by the מנחה.

phrases.english: Come and hear,
for Rabbi Chiyya taught:
It is stated here: "And he shall take up,"
phrases.notes: About the ashes (ויקרא ו:ג).

phrases.english: and it is stated there: "And he shall take up."
phrases.notes: About the מנחה (ויקרא ו:ח).

phrases.english: Just as there, it is with his handful,
so too here, it is with his handful.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: This answers רבי אבין's question from step 6.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The amount is a handful (קומץ), learned through a גזירה שוה from the מנחה. It is not a percentage taken from either type of תרומה.

steps.title: רב: four services carry מיתה for a זר
steps.stepSummary: רב rules that a זר gets מיתה בידי שמים for only four services: זריקה, הקטרה, ניסוך המים, and ניסוך היין.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב said: There are four services for which a non-כהן is liable to death: sprinkling the blood, burning on the מזבח, pouring the water, and pouring the wine.
steps.whatsHappening: A new topic begins. רב lists the only four services for which a זר who does them gets the death penalty.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב limits the death penalty to these four services. Other services, such as slaughtering or carrying the blood, are still forbidden to a זר but do not carry מיתה. The next steps will explain where רב gets this list.

keyTerms.meaning: A non-כהן
Liable to death (here, מיתה בידי שמים, death at the hands of Heaven)
Sprinkling or throwing the blood on the מזבח
Burning on the מזבח
Pouring a libation (water on סוכות, or wine)

steps.confusionAlert: רב is NOT saying a זר may do other services. Every עבודה is forbidden to a זר. This list only covers the services that carry the death penalty.

phrases.english: Rav said:
There are four services
for which a non-priest is liable to death:
sprinkling, and burning,
and the water libation, and the wine libation.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב: אַרְבַּע עֲבוֹדוֹת זָר חַיָּיב עֲלֵיהֶן מִיתָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new statement. It will soon return to תרומת הדשן through לוי's opinion.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A זר gets מיתה only for זריקה, הקטרה, ניסוך המים, and ניסוך היין.

steps.title: לוי adds the removal of the ashes
steps.stepSummary: לוי says that a זר also gets מיתה for תרומת הדשן. He taught the same thing in his own collection of ברייתות.
steps.simpleTranslation: And לוי said: Also for תרומת הדשן. And similarly לוי taught in his collection of ברייתות: Also תרומת הדשן.
steps.whatsHappening: לוי disagrees with רב and adds a fifth service to the list. The גמרא notes that לוי also taught this in his own ברייתות.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This creates a מחלוקת. For רב, a זר who does תרומת הדשן has done something forbidden but does not get מיתה. For לוי, he gets מיתה. The גמרא will now explain each side's reasoning.

keyTerms.meaning: Also; adds to the list
And so he taught; a supporting teaching
His collection of ברייתות

phrases.english: And Levi said: Also the removal of the ashes.
And similarly Levi taught in his collection of baraitot:
Also the removal of the ashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: This is the opposing opinion to רב's list in step 8.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A זר also gets מיתה for תרומת הדשן.

steps.title: רב's source: a service of giving that is complete
steps.stepSummary: רב learns his list from במדבר י״ח:ז. ״עבודת מתנה״ excludes a service of removal. ״ועבדתם״ means a complete service, not one that has another service after it.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is רב's reason? As it is written: "And you and your sons with you shall keep your כהונה in everything of the מזבח and within the curtain, and you shall serve. I give your כהונה as a service of gift, and the זר who comes near shall be put to death." "A service of gift" means a service of giving and not a service of removal. "And you shall serve" means a complete service, and not a service that has another service after it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks for רב's reason and answers with a פסוק. The same פסוק says the זר who comes near gets death.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Two words narrow the death penalty. ״מתנה״ (gift) means putting something onto the מזבח, so lifting ash off it (סילוק) is excluded, and that is why רב leaves out תרומת הדשן. ״ועבדתם״ means a finished service, so steps like שחיטה and קבלה, which lead to זריקה, are excluded.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?
A service of giving (placing something on the מזבח)
A service of removal (taking something off the מזבח)
A complete service, one that finishes the process
And the זר who comes near shall be put to death

steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up two tests for a death-penalty עבודה: it must be giving, and it must be final. The four services on רב's list pass both tests. תרומת הדשן fails the first.

phrases.english: What is Rav's reason? As it is written:
"And you and your sons with you
shall keep your priesthood
in everything pertaining to the altar
and to that within the curtain;
and you shall serve; as a service of gift
I give you your priesthood;
and the non-priest who draws near shall be put to death."
"A service of gift": and not a service of removal,
phrases.notes: This excludes תרומת הדשן.

phrases.english: "And you shall serve": a complete service,
and not a service that has another service after it.
phrases.notes: This excludes שחיטה, קבלה, and הולכה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: This explains the source of רב's limited list from step 8.
steps.raayaObject: רב's ruling that only four services carry מיתה for a זר, and that תרומת הדשן does not.
steps.raayaSupportSource: במדבר י״ח:ז, read through ״עבודת מתנה״ (giving, not removal) and ״ועבדתם״ (a complete service).

steps.title: לוי's source: everything of the מזבח
steps.stepSummary: לוי learns from ״לכל דבר המזבח״ that every service on the מזבח is included, even removing the ash.
steps.simpleTranslation: And לוי? The תורה included it with "in everything pertaining to the מזבח."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why לוי includes תרומת הדשן. He reads ״לכל דבר המזבח״ as covering every act on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For לוי, the phrase ״לכל דבר המזבח״ widens the rule to acts done on the מזבח. Even though תרומת הדשן is a removal, it is done on the מזבח, so the death penalty applies to it. Step 13 explains exactly which word of the phrase gives לוי this teaching.

keyTerms.meaning: The Torah (the Merciful One) included it
In everything pertaining to the מזבח

phrases.english: And Levi? The Merciful One included it with
"in everything pertaining to the altar."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: This gives לוי's reading of the same פסוק that רב used in step 10.
steps.raayaObject: לוי's ruling that a זר gets מיתה for תרומת הדשן.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The phrase ״לכל דבר המזבח״, which includes services done on the מזבח. Step 13 shows he learns תרומת הדשן specifically from ״דבר המזבח״.

steps.title: What רב learns from ״לכל דבר המזבח״
steps.stepSummary: רב uses ״לכל דבר המזבח״ to include the seven sprinklings done inside the היכל and the seven sprinklings of the מצורע. These are not done on the מזבח, but a זר still gets מיתה for them.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רב? That phrase comes to include the seven sprinklings done inside and those of the מצורע.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks what רב does with the phrase לוי used and answers that רב uses it for something else. This raises a follow-up question for לוי, which the next step answers.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The sprinklings toward the פרוכת, and the מצורע's sprinklings, are not done on the מזבח itself. Without ״לכל״ we might think they carry no death penalty. רב uses the extra word to include them, so it is no longer available to include תרומת הדשן.

keyTerms.meaning: To include; to bring in
Seven sprinklings
That are done inside (in the היכל, toward the פרוכת)
A person with צרעת; the oil sprinklings in his purification

steps.whatToRemember: רב: a זר gets מיתה only for a service that gives and completes (four services), plus the inner sprinklings and those of the מצורע through ״לכל״. לוי: ״לכל דבר המזבח״ also includes תרומת הדשן.

phrases.english: And Rav? That phrase comes
to include the seven sprinklings
that are inside, and those of the leper.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: This answers the unspoken question of how רב reads the phrase that לוי used in step 11.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: If רב does not use ״לכל דבר המזבח״ to include תרומת הדשן, what does he learn from it?
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: He uses it to include the seven inner sprinklings and the sprinklings of the מצורע in the death penalty for a זר.

steps.title: לוי learns two things from two words
steps.stepSummary: לוי needs the פסוק to teach two things: תרומת הדשן and the inner sprinklings. He gets one from ״דבר״ and the other from the extra word ״כל״.
steps.simpleTranslation: And לוי? He learns it from ״דבר״ and from ״כל דבר״.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers a hidden question. If לוי uses ״לכל דבר המזבח״ for תרומת הדשן, where does he learn the inner sprinklings that רב learned from it in Step 12?
steps.deeperAnalysis: לוי splits the phrase into two parts. The phrase ״דבר המזבח״ adds תרומת הדשן. The extra word ״כל״ (״כל דבר״) adds the seven inner sprinklings and the sprinklings of the מצורע. This way one phrase gives him both teachings.

keyTerms.meaning: He derives it / he learns it out
"Matter of" or "pertaining to". Here it is the word in ״דבר המזבח״
"Every matter". The extra word כל adds even more cases

phrases.english: And Levi, he derives it
phrases.notes: There's an unspoken question here: where does לוי learn the inner sprinklings from?

phrases.english: from "pertaining" and from "everything pertaining".
phrases.notes: ״דבר״ adds תרומת הדשן. ״כל״ adds the inner sprinklings.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְלֵוִי — נָפְקָא לֵיהּ מִ״דְּבַר״ וְ״כׇל דְּבַר״
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the obvious question raised by Step 12. רב used the phrase for the inner sprinklings, so where does לוי learn them?
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Where does לוי learn the inner sprinklings, if he used ״לכל דבר המזבח״ for תרומת הדשן?
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: He learns two teachings from the two layers of the phrase: ״דבר״ and ״כל דבר״.

steps.title: רב does not learn from the difference between the two words
steps.stepSummary: רב does not read anything into the difference between ״דבר״ and ״כל דבר״. So for him the phrase teaches only one thing: the inner sprinklings.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רב does not learn anything from ״דבר״ versus ״כל דבר״.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why רב does not get תרומת הדשן from the same phrase the way לוי does.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רב, ״לכל דבר המזבח״ is one phrase with one teaching. The extra word ״כל״ is not a separate source for him. So the phrase only covers the inner sprinklings. Removing the ash stays excluded by ״עבודת מתנה״.

keyTerms.meaning: He does not derive anything from it (he does not expound it)

steps.whatToRemember: The whole argument comes down to one question: is the word ״כל״ an extra source? לוי says yes, so he gets two teachings, including תרומת הדשן. רב says no, so he gets only one teaching, the inner sprinklings.

phrases.english: And Rav, "pertaining" and "everything pertaining"
phrases.notes: That is, the difference between the two wordings, with and without ״כל״.

phrases.english: he does not expound.
phrases.notes: For רב, the extra ״כל״ teaches nothing new.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives רב's side to match לוי's reading in Step 13.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why does רב not include תרומת הדשן from this phrase?
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: He does not learn anything from the difference between ״דבר״ and ״כל דבר״.

steps.title: A challenge to Levi from the rule of a general term followed by a specific term
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא argues that ״לכל דבר המזבח״ is a כלל and ״עבודת מתנה״ is a פרט. By the rule of כלל ופרט, only what the פרט names is included. That would mean giving-services count, but removing the ash does not.
steps.simpleTranslation: But say this: ״לכל דבר המזבח״ is a general term, and ״עבודת מתנה״ is a specific term. That is a כלל ופרט. The general term includes only what the specific term names. So giving-services are included, and removal-services are not.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks לוי. It uses a standard rule for reading the תורה to show that the פסוק might exclude תרומת הדשן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There is a rule called כלל ופרט. When a general term comes first and a specific term comes after it, the specific term limits the general one. If that rule applies here, the broad phrase ״לכל דבר המזבח״ is narrowed down to ״עבודת מתנה״ only, meaning services where something is given or placed. That would leave out תרומת הדשן, which is a removal, and so it would knock out לוי's teaching.

keyTerms.meaning: "But say...". Opens an alternative reading that challenges what was just said
A general term followed by a specific term. One of the rules for reading the תורה
The general term includes only what the specific term names
A service of removal, like taking the ash off the מזבח
Yes (Aramaic)

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two kinds of exclusion. Earlier (Step 10), רב excluded removal-services simply by reading the words ״עבודת מתנה״. Here, the גמרא uses the formal rule of כלל ופרט to get the same result against לוי. It is the same conclusion, but it comes through a different method.

phrases.english: But say: "in everything pertaining to the altar" is a generalization,
phrases.notes: The broad term comes first in the פסוק.

phrases.english: "a service of gift" is a specification,
phrases.notes: The narrow term comes after it.

phrases.english: it is a generalization and a specification.
The generalization includes only what is in the specification:
phrases.notes: This is the rule that applies.

phrases.english: a service of giving, yes,
a service of removal, no!
phrases.notes: This would exclude תרומת הדשן, which goes against לוי.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאֵימָא: ״לְכׇל דְּבַר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ״ — כָּלַל, ״עֲבוֹדַת מַתָּנָה״ — פָּרַט
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks לוי's reading from Step 13 by bringing in a formal rule for reading the תורה.
steps.kashyaTarget: לוי's teaching that a זר gets מיתה for תרומת הדשן, which he learned from ״לכל דבר המזבח״.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Under the rule of כלל ופרט, the specific term ״עבודת מתנה״ limits the general term ״לכל דבר המזבח״. That leaves out removal-services like תרומת הדשן.

steps.title: The answer begins: the verse says
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא starts to defend לוי by quoting the words of the פסוק. The quote itself comes on the next עמוד.
steps.whatsHappening: This is only a setup line. The גמרא is getting ready to answer the challenge, and the actual פסוק comes in the next part of the text.
steps.deeperAnalysis: ״אמר קרא״ tells us the answer will come from the words of a פסוק. It will show that the rule of כלל ופרט does not limit the phrase in this case. The details of the answer continue on the next עמוד.
